lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg24Ga12 (reduced formula Mg2Ga) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over 8 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ga centers with 9 or 10 Mg neighbors, while Mg centers adopt 10- to 14-neighbor environments, including 12-vertex close-packed-like local arrangements. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between 10-vertex Ga and 12-vertex Mg polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Mg polyhedra.
